reviews.author: Total ECommerce LTD
reviews.title: Excellent Support for Our EU Warehouse Launch
reviews.text: As a UK company, we’ve recently opened a warehouse in the EU, and Vareya has been incredibly helpful throughout the setup process. Their team has gone above and beyond to help us get our goods shipped into the country and make the whole process run smoothly.With full access to the EU market, we’re excited about the opportunities ahead and look forward to continuing our partnership with Vareya. Thank you for all your support!

reviews.author: Fil Foods BV
reviews.title: An incredible early partner
reviews.text: VareYa took a chance on us when we were just starting out. Most other 3PL's would have simply said no stating minimum volumes and the like, but VareYa were happy to take us on, understanding our ambition to set up with a reliable 3PL partner early and grow together.Almost three years later, as we have grown VareYa have enabled us to keep up with demand to a high degree of success. We work as partners, regularly looking at ways we can improve our processes and ensure mutual success. We are looking forward to growing further with VareYa into the future as a key supplier for us and our supply chain.

reviews.author: PRIMAL FX LLC
reviews.title: VAREYA REVIEW
reviews.text: We're so happy with the service provided. We look forward to visiting your facility's ASAP.

reviews.author: Sana VDM
reviews.title: Director
reviews.text: We've been working with Vareya for over 5 years now, and we've always had a great experience with them. Special thanks to Raymond, who's been amazing to work with over the years. He's always responsive, helpful, and does his best to find solutions whenever we need something. Really appreciate all the support and looking forward to many more years working together!
